title: Preparing a Debate Outline
text:
A debate outline is a plan that helps you prepare for a debate. It shows your main claim and the reasons that support it. Good outlines also include evidence, such as facts, examples, or expert opinions. Before you write, decide which points are the strongest.

Many students write the outline as a simple list. First, they write the introduction with their claim. Then, they write each reason under its own heading. Finally, they add a short section for the other side's arguments, so they can answer them during the debate.

questions.text: According to the passage, what does a debate outline show?
options: Your main claim and the reasons that support it

questions.text: According to paragraph two, what do students write first?
options: A list of the other side's arguments
A short summary of the debate

questions.text: Why do students add a section for the other side's arguments?
options: So they can answer those arguments during the debate
Because the outline must be very long
Because the other side writes their outline
Because judges only read that section

questions.text: What can you infer about the strongest points in an outline?
options: They can help you win the debate more easily
They should be placed at the end and ignored
They are the same for every debate
They do not need any evidence

vocabulary.definition: a short plan that shows the main parts of something
a statement that you believe is true and try to prove
facts or examples that show something is true
reasons given to support or oppose an idea

paragraph_translations: Un esquema de debate es un plan que te ayuda a prepararte para un debate. Muestra tu afirmación principal y las razones que la apoyan. Los buenos esquemas también incluyen pruebas, como datos, ejemplos u opiniones de expertos. Antes de escribir, decide cuáles son los puntos más fuertes.

Muchos estudiantes escriben el esquema como una lista sencilla. Primero, escriben la introducción con su afirmación. Luego, escriben cada razón bajo su propio título. Por último, añaden una sección breve con los argumentos del otro lado, para poder responderlos durante el debate.
